scope: Exactly 1074 current required clips for50 nonfiction books,440 pages and50 titles; 755 other clips reuse unchanged prior registered role/text/path/hash evidence.
method: Complete FFmpeg decode; finite unclipped24kHz signal;50ms RMS speech windows; unprompted offline faster-whisper tiny,small and small.en with no reference text. Material word/phoneme uncertainties receive new Leda recordings. Each residual spelling/number/homophone difference has an individual disposition. Contextual heteronyms bind exact source sentence or title, voice and bytes.
limitations: Automated signal, source and linguistic evidence; not human listening. Heteronym controls retain exact IPA synthesis payloads and word-recognition output; spelling-only ASR does not independently prove stress or every phoneme. US homophones are explicitly recorded, not counted as exact spelling matches. Reader playback/interruption and device layouts are separate pending checks.

pronunciationControls.titleContexts: Explicit pageNumber title allows exact title-word review without changing unrelated default pronunciation.
